title: Boladona
desc_lfm_album: Boladona is the second studio album by Brazilian funkista Tati Quebra Barraco, released in 2004. The title track, which the funkista almost refused to record, was chosen on the soundtrack of the soap opera on TV Globo, América (2005). .
desc_lfm_artist:
Tatiana dos Santos Lourenço, better known as Tati Quebra Barraco, is a Brazilian singer and songwriter of funk carioca, recognized as one of the pioneers in the musical genre, and one of the main exponents of the style. 

Tati was born and raised on the outskirts of Rio de Janeiro, in the favela of Cidade de Deus.

Her work has songs that openly talk about sex, female empowerment, independence and self-love. For this reason, Tati Quebra Barraco has become a feminist and LGBTQ+ icon.
